Welcome to Compton College—Where every student is a success story!
As we approach our Centennial in 2027, we are proud of our history and focused on
the work ahead: helping students complete their educational goals, transfer to a university,
at Compton College. We are proud to serve our students and community, and we look
forward to continuing this work as we celebrate 100 years of Compton College.
